cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(easyfly_fuel_native LANGUAGES C CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(Eigen3 REQUIRED)
find_package(PCL REQUIRED COMPONENTS common filters)
find_package(yaml-cpp REQUIRED)
find_package(NLopt CONFIG REQUIRED)
if(TARGET NLopt::nlopt)
 set(fuel_nlopt NLopt::nlopt)
else()
 set(fuel_nlopt NLopt::nlopt_cxx)
endif()
set(base fuel_planner)
file(GLOB lkh_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${base}/utils/lkh_tsp_solver/src/*.c)
list(FILTER lkh_sources EXCLUDE REGEX "/LKHmain[.]c$")
add_library(fuel_lkh SHARED ${lkh_sources} ${base}/utils/lkh_tsp_solver/src/lkh_interface.cpp)
target_compile_options(fuel_lkh PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:C>:-fcommon>)
target_include_directories(fuel_lkh PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${base}/utils/lkh_tsp_solver/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include/fuel_native>)
target_link_libraries(fuel_lkh PRIVATE m)
add_library(fuel_native SHARED
 ${base}/bspline/src/non_uniform_bspline.cpp ${base}/bspline_opt/src/bspline_optimizer.cpp
 ${base}/plan_env/src/sdf_map.cpp ${base}/plan_env/src/raycast.cpp ${base}/plan_env/src/edt_environment.cpp
 ${base}/active_perception/src/frontier_finder.cpp ${base}/active_perception/src/graph_node.cpp
 ${base}/active_perception/src/perception_utils.cpp ${base}/path_searching/src/astar2.cpp
 ${base}/exploration_manager/src/fast_exploration_manager.cpp)
foreach(module plan_env active_perception path_searching exploration_manager bspline bspline_opt)
 target_include_directories(fuel_native PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${base}/${module}/include>)
 install(DIRECTORY ${base}/${module}/include/ DESTINATION include/fuel_native)
endforeach()
target_include_directories(fuel_native PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/fuel_support/include> $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:include/fuel_native> ${PCL_INCLUDE_DIRS})
target_link_libraries(fuel_native PUBLIC fuel_lkh Eigen3::Eigen yaml-cpp ${PCL_LIBRARIES})
target_compile_options(fuel_native PRIVATE -O2)
target_link_libraries(fuel_native PRIVATE ${fuel_nlopt})
target_link_options(fuel_native PRIVATE -Wl,--no-undefined)
install(DIRECTORY fuel_support/include/ ${base}/utils/lkh_tsp_solver/include/ DESTINATION include/fuel_native)
install(TARGETS fuel_native fuel_lkh EXPORT fuelTargets LIBRARY DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES LICENSE README.md DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(FILES ../fuel.provenance.json ../fuel.ros2-highlevel.patch ../fuel.original-selected.tar.gz ../fuel.original-extended-selected.tar.gz DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}/provenance)
install(DIRECTORY ../fuel.notices/ DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}/notices)
ament_export_targets(fuelTargets HAS_LIBRARY_TARGET)
ament_export_dependencies(Eigen3 PCL yaml-cpp)
ament_package()
